description: This file defines the 'SubjectModified' event class within the 'org.eclipse.ditto.signals.events.policies' package. It models an immutable event triggered after a 'Subject' within a policy has been modified, including JSON serialization/deserialization, property accessors, and related metadata.

classes.name: SubjectModified
classes.description: Immutable event class representing a 'subjectModified' event in the policy system, with JSON serialization/deserialization support, property accessors, and overridden equality/hash code methods.

methods.name: of

methods.description: Creates a SubjectModified instance from a JSON string or JSON object along with headers.

methods.description: Returns the label associated with the modified subject.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns an optional JSON representation of the subject entity.
